message: AXTAG unverifiable on `quiet`: `effect(div)` cannot be checked: nothing in the compiler infers that effect, so no body ever supplies it
help: `Div` and `Err` are spellable and never inferred - zero of this repository's 3,040 effect rows carry either. The claim is recorded and nothing validates it. Divergence is not inferred because the cheapest sound rule - a self-call, or any `while` - marks most of a real program non-terminating; `(handle BODY (Pure) 0)` is the construct that does refuse, and it measures IO, Alloc and Mut

message: AXTAG mismatch on `honest`: `effect(mut)` claim unsupported: missing Mut
help: an AXTAG is a CLAIM, and this is the compiler answering it: make the body match the tag, or correct the tag to what the body does. Deleting the tag also silences this, and an untagged function is never checked - but that WITHDRAWS the claim rather than answering it, and every reader that trusted the tag loses the guarantee. A claim the walk cannot check is AX3037 and stays a warning; this code fires only where the walk has an answer
